superable.definition: s capable of being surmounted or excelled
superable.translation:
a. 可以胜过的, 可征服的
[法] 可超越的, 可胜过的

superabound.definition:
v. i. To be very abundant or exuberant; to be more than
   sufficient; as, the country superabounds with corn.

superabsorbent.translation:
adj. 超强吸收能力的
n. 具超强吸收能力的物质

superabundance.definition: n a quantity that is more than what is appropriate
superabundance.translation: n. 多余, 过多, 剩余

superabundant.translation: a. 过多的, 有余的

superacid.translation: a. 太酸的, 酸性过多的

superactinide element.translation: [化] 后锕系元素; 第二锕系元素

superactinides.translation: 超锕系元素, 第二锕系元素(第122-153元素)

superadd.definition:
v. t. To add over and above; to add to what has been added;
   to annex, as something extrinsic.
superadd.translation: vt. 外加, 加上, 添上, 附加地说

superadded.translation: v. 再加上, 添加( superadd的过去式和过去分词 )

superadding.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Superadd
superadding.translation: v. 再加上, 添加( superadd的现在分词 )

superaddition.definition:
n. The act of adding something in excess or something
   extraneous; also, something which is added in excess or extraneously.
superaddition.translation: n. 外加, 加上, 添上, 添加物

superaerodynamics.translation: [复] n.[用作单]稀薄气体动力学

superagency.translation: n. (管理和协调一批较小机构的)政府超级机构

superalimentation.definition:
n. The act of overfeeding, or making one take food
   in excess of the natural appetite for it.
superalimentation.translation: 超量营养法, 强饲法

superalloy.translation: [化] 高温合金; 超合金

superalloys.translation: (superalloy 的复数) [化] 高温合金; 超合金

superaltar.definition:
n. A raised shelf or stand on the back of an altar, on
   which different objects can be placed; a predella or gradino.

superaltern.translation: n. [逻]全称命题(指对一类事物的全部作出的判断)

superannuable.translation: a. <主英>(职务等)退休后可领取养老金的

superannuate.definition:
v. retire and pension (someone) because of age or physical inability
v. declare to be obsolete
v. become obsolete
superannuate.translation: vt. 给养老金使退休, 因体弱令...退职, 因年老令...退职, 淘汰, 废弃

superannuated.definition:
v retire and pension (someone) because of age or physical inability
v declare to be obsolete
v become obsolete
v retire or become ineligible because of old age or infirmity
s too old to be useful
s old; no longer valid or fashionable
superannuated.translation: a. 年老退休的, 老朽的, 体弱退休的, 领养老金的, 过时的, 太旧的, 废弃的

superannuates.definition:
v retire and pension (someone) because of age or physical inability
v declare to be obsolete
v become obsolete
v retire or become ineligible because of old age or infirmity
superannuates.translation: v. 因落后于时代而废除, 勒令退学( superannuate的第三人称单数 )

superannuating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Superannuate
superannuating.translation: v. 因落后于时代而废除, 勒令退学( superannuate的现在分词 )

superannuation.definition: n. the act of discharging someone because of age (especially to cause someone to retire from service on a pension)
superannuation.translation: n. 年老退休, 退职, 体弱退休, 淘汰, 废弃, 退休金

superannuation payment.translation: [经] 由工资中扣除应缴年金贡献的付款方法

superanthracite.translation: 超无烟煤; 变无烟煤

superaudiable.translation: 超音频的, 超声波的
